name: code-structure-inspector
description: Read-only code evidence and a Codex GPT workflow for source-backed responsibilities, dependency meaning and native visualization.

interface.longDescription: Inspect bounded local syntax facts, then let Codex GPT explain responsibilities and candidate impact from selected source evidence and return a native visualization. No external AI API or custom LLM runtime.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain my code responsibilities and dependency meaning with source evidence and a native visualization.
